scheduledJobs.turnError: The maintainer hit an error this turn: {error}
scheduledJobs.interrupted: This run was interrupted partway (the daemon restarted, or the maintainer's child process exited unexpectedly) and won't be redone
scheduledJobs.blocked.handOver: needs you to do it yourself: “{tool}”
scheduledJobs.dropped: {state}, so the queued run won't happen
scheduledJobs.projectGone: The project it belongs to has been deleted
scheduledJobs.workOrderNotDone: This run's work order wasn't completed
scheduledJobs.autoPaused.title: Scheduled task “{title}” was paused automatically
scheduledJobs.autoPaused.head_one: Failed {n} time in a row. It won't run on schedule until you deal with it:
scheduledJobs.autoPaused.head_other: Failed {n} times in a row. It won't run on schedule until you deal with it:
scheduledJobs.autoPaused.tail: Once you've found the cause, tap “Resume” to run on schedule again, or leave it paused for now.
scheduledJobs.refusal.noTrigger: Task {taskId} isn't a scheduled task (or isn't registered yet)
scheduledJobs.refusal.notNow: Scheduled task “{title}” is {state} right now, so “{action}” isn't available
scheduledJobs.refusal.projectRetired: Project “{project}” is retired: re-enable it on the project page first, and its scheduled tasks will resume with it
scheduledJobs.refusal.projectArchived: Project “{project}” is archived: unarchive it first, and its scheduled tasks will resume with it
scheduledJobs.refusal.noSchedule: “{title}” is triggered by events and has no schedule, so it can't be rescheduled. To run it on a schedule, cancel it and create a new one with "Scheduled" when starting a task
scheduledJobs.refusal.oncePassed: The time {at} has already passed: pick a time in the future
scheduledJobs.refusal.stillRunning: “{title}” is still running from last time. Try again once it's done
scheduledJobs.refusal.stillQueued: “{title}” from last time is still queued (waiting for a slot). Try again once it has run
scheduledJobs.refusal.needsEvent: “{title}” has steps that use values from the event, and a manual run has no event to fill them in. It'll run by itself when the event comes
scheduledJobs.legacyPlanJobs: The plan's scheduled jobs were turned into scheduled tasks {titles}
scheduledJobs.onceMissed: Originally due {at}: the daemon wasn't running then, so it runs once now that it's back
scheduledJobs.interruptedNote: The last input was interrupted while being handled, and the maintainer didn't pick it back up. {reason}.
scheduledJobs.interruptedNoteQuoted: The last input “{quoted}” was interrupted while being handled, and the maintainer didn't pick it back up. {reason}.
